map.公差叠加计算器（最差情形）求线性尺寸链在最差情况下的总公差累积，适合机械装配的公: This worst-case tolerance stackup calculator gives the total tolerance accumulation of a linear dimension chain under worst-case conditions, suited to tolerance design and clearance risk estimation in mechanical assembly.
map.安全关键、单件或小批量装配中，用最坏情况（Worst Case）叠加估算总公差上: In safety-critical, single-piece or small-batch assembly, the worst-case stack gives an upper bound on total tolerance and guarantees 100% conformance.

map.合同/法规要求的极限尺寸校核，必须按极值法给出保证值。: Limit-dimension checks required by contract or regulation must use the extreme-value method to give guaranteed values.
map.：总公差 T = t₁ + t₂ + … + tₙ，直接把各组成环公差线性相加（: Total tolerance T = t₁ + t₂ + … + tₙ simply adds the component tolerances linearly, assuming all take extreme values in the same direction. The method makes no distribution assumption and yields a conservative upper bound.
map.：同段尺寸链公差 0.1、0.15、0.2 mm 按最坏情况叠加：T = 0.1: For the same chain with tolerances 0.1, 0.15 and 0.2 mm, worst-case stacking gives T = 0.1 + 0.15 + 0.2 = 0.450 mm, far larger than the 0.269 mm from RSS. That means guaranteeing 100% conformance with WC requires every part to be held much tighter (or a larger design clearance), which costs more; high-volume cases usually switch to RSS for a typical value.
map.最坏情况法会不会过度设计？: Does the worst-case method lead to over-design?
map.会。它假定所有误差同时取同向极值，实际概率极低，按此控公差常导致不必要的高加工成: Yes. It assumes all errors simultaneously take extreme values in the same direction, which has a very low real probability, so controlling tolerances this way often brings unnecessary machining cost. It is only worthwhile where any out-of-tolerance condition is unacceptable, such as aerospace or medical implants.
map.能和 RSS 混用吗？: Can it be combined with RSS?
map.可以分工：对系统性偏差（偏移）用加减法，对随机公差用 RSS；也可对关键环用 W: Yes, divide the work: use the plus/minus method for systematic bias (offset) and RSS for random tolerances. You can also apply WC to critical links and RSS to non-critical ones for a hybrid allocation that balances safety and cost.
